run_ForwardModelsVal: run ForwardModelsVal to perform a forward pass on a validation batch for a specific task
run_ForwardModelsTrain: run ForwardModelsTrain to perform a forward pass on a training batch with gradient tracking
build_LoadDatasets: build LoadDatasets to create training and validation data loaders for multiple VQA tasks
build_LoadDatasetEval: build LoadDatasetEval to create evaluation data loaders for multiple VQA tasks
run_EvaluatingModel: run EvaluatingModel to evaluate a model on a batch and collect prediction results
